title: Just-Add-Water Mason Jar Cookbook: 120 Easy Pantry Meals for Cozy Breakfasts, Hearty Soups
description: A homemade meal can be a whole lot easier when the ingredients are already measured and waiting for you. The Just-Add-Water Mason Jar Cookbook brings together 120 practical pantry meals you can pack ahead in mason jars and prepare later with water. From warm breakfasts and savory grain bowls to comforting soups, chilis, noodles, and one-pot meals, these recipes are designed to take some of the planning out of everyday cooking. Inside, you’ll find: 120 just-add-water mason jar recipes Sweet and savory breakfast jars Couscous, bulgur, and instant rice bowls Noodles and brothy pasta meals Lentil, split pea, bean, chili, and potato recipes One-pot pasta and comfort-food favorites Clear water measurements in cups and milliliters Simple Pack the Jar and To Prepare directions Helpful doneness cues, allergen notes, and storage guidance The recipes are built around water-only preparation using a covered boiling-water rest or stovetop cooking—without requiring butter, oil, fresh milk, fresh eggs, an oven, air fryer, or broiler. You’ll also learn how to choose suitable dry ingredients, fit recipes comfortably into the right jar, label your meals clearly, store them thoughtfully, and know what to look for when it’s time to cook. Pack it ahead. Add water when you’re ready.
